name: Edrim's recycle menu with more Mythic items than gossip options does not crash the server (#8180)
contract: Edrim Skysong's recycle menu adds one gossip option per recyclable Mythic item after her info lines. With about
30 items the menu passed GOSSIP_MAX_MENU_ITEMS (32) and GossipMenu::AddMenuItem's ASSERT took the world server
down. AddMenuItem now drops options past the limit, and the recycle menu stops one short so Back still fits. A
character with 40 Mythic 1 robes opens the menu, sees 32 options, and can still recycle the first one.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the menu is capped at 32 options
the server is still up and one robe is recycled
